lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Ricardo Coutinho | Lesson 10 -- Miami, Gate 12
lesson.grammar_point: question words: what, where, who, how long

listenings.text: Good evening. This is a boarding announcement for flight two four one, to Miami. Boarding is now at gate twelve. Please have your passport and your boarding pass in your hand. Passengers with small children board first. The flight time to Miami is eight hours and twenty minutes. Thank you, and have a good flight.

Good morning, sir. Welcome to Miami. Passport, please. What is the purpose of your trip? Where do you stay in Miami? How long is your trip? Who travels with you today? Thank you. Please look at the camera. Everything is fine. Welcome to the United States, and have a good day.

extra_audio.text: The flight to Miami is at gate twelve. I show my passport and my boarding pass. The flight is eight hours and twenty minutes. In Miami an officer asks four questions. I answer, and he says welcome.
